facts.claim: Celebrity Edge (Celebrity Cruises): Entered service 2018; 129,500 GT; 2900 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 290 m length; Edge class.
Discover Celebrity Edge. View the award-winning luxury cruise ship's deck plan, staterooms, dining options, things to do and upcoming sailings.
Celebrity Edge is an Edge-class cruise ship operated by Celebrity Cruises, a subsidiary of Royal Caribbean Group.
Upon delivery in October 2018, at 130,818 GT, she became the lead ship of the Edge class and the largest ship by gross tonnage to have joined the Celebrity fleet.
